scope: Current roster, runtime manifests and registered static artwork. No animation production, pixels, runtime settings or catalogue IDs are changed.

stages.note: A stage can register several rooms. Plane counts are not stage counts. An unset block flag does not establish that enough references exist.

projectiles.note: Default enabled projectile commands only. Weapon phase kits, traps, impact VFX and unrelated environmental effects are excluded. One image may serve several exact owner/source/slot routes.

chronicles.note: Fifteen configured story routes, not one story for every roster profile. Observation illustrations are used by three routes instead of a rival duel image; sightings are supplementary.

clips.note: A clip is animated only with at least two distinct pixel signatures. A static attack pose, repeated image or extra clip key does not create a new character or animation.

variants.note: Metadata variants include weapons, forms, sizes and editions. They overlap the roster and are not an independent costume catalogue.

missingEvidence.reason: Tool rejected the attempted full-body SMG variant under violence. No image from another weapon is substituted.

weapons.note: Weapon phases reuse commands; four phase kits do not establish eighty missing drawings or four additional characters. The absent Memory of Alessa SMG idle has a documented prior generation refusal and is not an open production target.

assets.note: File presence is checked in the current Git commit or on disk. Sparse checkout absence is not a missing production asset. No pixel decoding, integrity against PNG bytes, visual approval or remote publication check is performed.

corpus.note: Documentary records are not executable packs, required new fighters, or finished gameplay.

propsAndOtherVFX.note: Foreground decor is included in stage planes. No separate exhaustive props, nonprojectile VFX or impact-image inventory defines a defensible percentage.

audio.mode: Procedural Web Audio cues in src/shared.js and src/lore-cinematics.js; not a completed source-audio asset library.

catalogDefinitions.meaning: Configured data definitions, not a percentage of finished artwork or completed playthroughs.

interpretationWarnings: Portrait and combat coverage overlap; missing counts must not be added as unique profiles.
Bosses and variants are subsets of the same roster, not additional characters.
A side-view image may belong to a noncombatant or an unresolved role; combatEnabled is reported separately.
The historical activePNG count includes all registered room variants; the default scene plane count has a narrower scope.
coverageComplete in content-stats.json concerns catalogue definitions; it does not mean that all art is complete.
A stage without a reference block flag may still lack adequate visual references; see its production research.
No 1:1 fidelity, UHD resolution, complete game, finished animation, release status or online deployment is inferred from these counts.
Earlier production README/summary publication fields are historical snapshots; current PR/CI status requires a separate live GitHub check.
